statements.proposition: This change modifies changelog_generics.md to remove its multiapi-specific section.
statements.label: TRUE
statements.note: The multiapi heading '# Autorest v3 to v4, if the package is multiapi' and the '## General Breaking changes' subheading were replaced by '# Breaking changes in generated packages'; the body text under it was kept, so the section was retitled rather than deleted wholesale, but the multiapi-specific framing is gone.
evidence: patch removes '# Autorest v3 to v4, if the package is multiapi' and adds '# Breaking changes in generated packages'

statements.proposition: This change is backward-compatible: all packages are processed via the standard single-API path.
statements.label: CANNOT_TELL
statements.note: No concrete check settles this. The change removes the 'multiapi_combiner' console-script entry point and the keyword parameter is_multiapi from change_log_generate; git grep at head and base over eng/ and scripts/ finds no caller passing is_multiapi and no other use of multiapi_combiner (sdk/ not checked). However, multiapi_combiner.py itself is NOT deleted (despite the PR text) and still loads the deleted templates/multiapi_combiner directory, and sdk_generator.py is not in the change list, so 'all packages will now be processed using the single-API path' is not something this diff does. Whether removing the script counts as breaking is a matter of reading.
evidence: PR file list: 14 files; sdk_generator.py and multiapi_combiner.py absent from the change list
